description: Flappy Bird (Flöppy Bird, faithful Love2D clone by NiroUwU, native Linux)
long: Flappy Bird is a minimalist arcade game in which the player taps to keep a bird aloft, threading it through an endless series of pipe gaps for as high a score as possible. The original 2013 mobile hit by .Gears had no PC release. This package ships "Floppy Bird", a faithful open-source clone by NiroUwU built on the LOVE (Love2D) engine and run natively on Linux.
name: Flappy Bird
